question: Should Synsepalum dulcificum be recommended for: use as a novel food (berries) in the EU?

records.notes: The European Commission terminated the procedure for authorising the berries of Synsepalum dulcificum (miracle berry, Richadella dulcifica) as a novel food without updating the Union list of authorised novel foods.
records.source_title: Commission Implementing Decision terminating the authorisation procedure for Synsepalum dulcificum berries as a novel food
records.target_indication: use as a novel food (berries) in the EU
records.primary_outcome: use as a novel food (berries) in the EU
